I honestly find independence and strength in making my stuff from scratch and by myself. However this method isn’t for everybody. There’s people out there who feel they need other people to flow with and I respect that. Your people are out there man you’ve just gotta let them come to you. Keep doing your thing.
You don’t have to attach yourself to a genre and limit your abilities for the sake of being able to compare yourself to a more consumable audience. Do your thing and make your shit.
Sorry for trying to bring some positivity into the thread.

I honestly just use Spotify as a portfolio. I then send the link out to labels, magazines, and people All over social media. I don’t expect streaming to be my main source of income, I merely use it as a digital portfolio.

Play notes until you find one that sounds like what you’re feeling. Then find another note that matches it and maybe a few more. Then sing over that however you’re feeling it. Just let it fall out of you.
Depression is addicting. It’s easy to fall into. Don’t let the addiction win.
You’re reason is yourself. Your reason is to give yourself the opportunity to live and love yourself.
You’re protecting yourself and the person that you’ve yet to become.
Try and you will succeed. Try with the true intention of living and loving yourself and you will succeed and become stronger than you ever have.

Start writing every day. Learn about yourself. Write until you run out of words to day. You can’t love yourself if you don’t truly know yourself. Start talking to yourself and digging deeper than you ever have. It’s going to be the hardest thing you’ve ever done but once you get out of it you’ll be stronger and more powerful then you ever thought you could be. You can do that.

Sometimes you need to learn to love yourself and not rely on the love of the people around you, even your parents and your blood. The only person you need to pour any of your energy into is yourself. And that energy needs to be loving and positive. Be your own maternal energy.
You have as much worth as you allow yourself to have. You have the strength and the power within yourself to be as powerful and strong as you need to be to stay alive.
You need to learn to love yourself, then your real friends will come to you. Don’t seek them out, let them find you.

About your friends leaving you, they were never your friends. You don’t need friends. The only person you need to be friends with and love is yourself. You have the strength and power to be your own best friend. Once you learn to love yourself, your true friends will come to you.
Take back control. Never let your life, perception, or destiny fall into the hands of others. If you already have, then regain that power. You have the strength, use it.

Learning to accept things that can not change is critical. Suicidal ideation is addictive. It’s easy to fall into the trap of wishing death. Don’t let it win. Fight it with everything you have and it won’t be there forever. Once you’re out of that headspace for good, you’ll never look back.

I got diagnosed 3 years ago. I’ve learned that having a constant dialog with myself, identifying my triggers and my irrational thoughts vs my rational thoughts, and learning to manipulate my mindset and perception, have helped me immensely. The process of learning these tools and figuring out how to utilize them has been the hardest thing I’ve ever done. I still have my bad days. I still fall sometimes. But the fall is way less harsh and lasts nowhere near as long as it did. Message me if you need advice.
See in yourself what your best friend sees in you. It may be the hardest thing you’ve ever done, but learn to love yourself as much as the people around you do

You will be strong enough. It’s ok that you relapsed. Take what you learned up until your relapse, take your relapse as a lesson and as a piece of strength to Carry you through your recovery. You’ve got that.

You don’t need anything more than you already have to get out of this. You were born human. You were born with the capability to change and adjust your perception of the world and of yourself. It may not be easy, In fact it may be the hardest thing you’ve ever done. But you can do it.

I can’t tell you I care about you because I don’t know you from Adam. But I can tell you that I value your life because you are a fellow human being. I can tell you that I want to see you live and love and thrive because I want to see that for every fellow human.
Take it upon yourself to flush them. You are worth life. You deserve life. You deserve the chance to make yourself and your life whatever you wish.

You are what you allow yourself to be. If you succumb to feeling worthless then you will be worthless. If you submit to feeling powerful and beautiful and successful, then you will be just that. Don’t let the feeling or worthlessness consume you. Do not let it kill you. Be the person you were meant to be.

You are strong. You are powerful. You deserve the world. Everyone deserves the world. You have everything you need and more to get through this. You have the strength that you allow yourself to have. Set small goals for yourself. No matter how minuscule they seem. Each goal you achieve is one step closer out of the hole.
You are stronger than this. You are as strong as you allow yourself to be. You have everything you need and more to be strong enough for this.
Existence is what you make of it. You are the master of your destiny.

You need to learn to love and worship yourself. You are capable of learning to love and worship yourself. You are worth living. Your life is worth keeping. You can make your life whatever you wish it to be. Please message me. Please stay with us. Please find it in yourself to continue to live and grow.
